summary: Phase 19 Photo Mode testing completed — all core features, night mode, camera controls, and regression tests passed successfully

Photo mode entry from HUD button hides all game UI (HUD, toolbar, objectives, scenario tracker)
Photo mode overlay renders with letterbox bars, PHOTO MODE label, and hint text
Rule-of-thirds grid toggle shows/hides grid lines correctly
Pause toggle in photo mode controls game.state.paused (freeze-the-moment feature)
Camera zoom works in photo mode (mouse wheel changes cam.zoom)
Camera pan works in photo mode (right-click drag changes cam.x/cam.y)
CAPTURE button produces preview dialog with PNG data URL (4.8MB image with vignette and caption plate)
Download anchor has correct .png filename and data URL href
Retake button returns to framing mode (closes preview, shows capture controls)
SPACE key captures photo (keyboard shortcut works)
Done button exits photo mode and restores HUD
ESC key exits photo mode (keyboard shortcut works)
Photo mode works at night with darker scene rendering (tick set to 1550 night phase)
Night photo capture successful with no console errors
HUD fully restored after exiting photo mode
Build toolbar visible and functional after photo mode exit
Terrain tools (raise, lower, flatten, smooth) clickable and working
Species Database modal opens correctly
Save functionality works (toast confirmation received)
Photo mode re-entry works without corruption
Scenario mode picker shows 5 scenarios (first_light, skitter_bloom, containment_crisis, night_bloom, sovereign_containment)
Scenario tracker visible in scenario mode
Scenario tracker correctly hidden when entering photo mode
Scenario tracker restored when exiting photo mode
No JavaScript console errors (only PostHog performance warning unrelated to photo mode)
Existing test suite /app/tests/phase19_photo_test.py passes 10/10 tests
